goals.noCriterion: Do not confirm a criterion yet
goals.confirmCriterionDescription: Select retained evidence and record why it proves this success criterion.
goals.applyReviewDescription: Review the proposed brief, next review date, and bounded tasks before applying them to the Goal.
goals.proposalStale: This item depends on Goal state that changed after generation.

goals.retainedResultsDescription: Accepted Task output, not a Goal achievement confirmation.
goals.resultDidNotConfirm: What this result did not confirm
goals.criterionEvidenceSummary: Goal success criteria and achievement evidence remain unconfirmed.
goals.whyNotAchievedDescription: This Goal has no achievement confirmation and no evidence confirming its success criteria. Accepted Task results remain available, but they never mark a Goal as successful automatically.

scheduleAiPanel.autoPlanGenerationDescription: Start task plan generation after saving a task. On by default; disable to require manual Regenerate.
scheduleAiPanel.defaultAutoExecuteDescription: Preselect auto-execute when creating scheduled tasks. Off by default so tasks only run automatically after opt-in.
scheduleAiPanel.autoSuggestionsDescription: Send typed task titles to the configured AI provider and show reviewable suggestions. Off by default; each suggestion is applied only when selected.

aiClientsPage.title: AI Clients
aiClientsPage.subtitle: Connect an AI client so Chrona can plan tasks and safely execute approved work.
aiClientsPage.emptyState: No AI client is connected yet. Connect one to unlock planning, suggestions, and execution previews.
aiClientsPage.hermesIntro: Hermes is Chrona's local AI runtime. It generates task plans, proposes schedule changes, and only executes after your approval.
aiClientsPage.hermesLocalDescription: Local mode can install the Chrona Hermes plugin and enable the Hermes API server on this machine.
aiClientsPage.hermesRemoteDescription: Remote mode will not touch local files. Configure the remote Hermes machine manually, then test availability here.
aiClientsPage.hermesRestartDescription: Restart Hermes if you changed the plugin, enabled the API server, or updated the API key. Chrona can run hermes gateway restart, but it may not know your original gateway startup options; restart it yourself if that is clearer. Running tasks may pause briefly during restart.
aiClientsPage.hermesRestartRequired: Restart Hermes, then run diagnosis again.
aiClientsPage.setAsDefaultHelp: Chrona uses the default client for planning, execution, and summaries unless a feature has its own client.
aiClientsPage.readinessConfiguredDetail: Client is enabled and required settings are complete.
aiClientsPage.readinessDisabledDetail: Client is disabled or required settings are missing.
aiClientsPage.readinessRunHealthCheck: Click “Test availability” to confirm this provider is reachable.
aiClientsPage.readinessCapabilityDetail: Supports task start, live progress, stop, tool use, and structured result validation.
aiClientsPage.readinessCapabilityUnknown: Provider capability matrix is not registered.
aiClientsPage.recoveryFull: Can reconnect to an active task and sync the final state.
aiClientsPage.recoverySnapshotOnly: Can sync run state; live progress is not replayed after disconnect.
aiClientsPage.recoverySessionHistory: Session context is saved; if execution is interrupted, retry this step to continue.
aiClientsPage.recoveryUnavailable: Interrupted runs cannot be recovered automatically.
